title: Logic Builder: block-built logic with generated ports
description: Logic Builder holds a visual block workspace (`workspace`) from which it generates JavaScript (`generatedCode`); the blocks' declared inputs and outputs become the node's ports, exactly like a Function node's script does. Here the generated logic turns a name into a greeting: the text input feeds the block-declared `name` input, `run` executes, and the block-declared `greeting` output lands in a Text. Use it where non-programmers must be able to read and edit the logic; use Function for anything a programmer maintains.
